player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Tower of Hanoi with {num_disks} disks.
You have to move the disks from tower A to tower C.
To move a disk, type the source tower and the target tower (e.g., '[A C]').
Note that you can only move the top disk of a tower, and that a bigger disk cannot be placed on a smaller disk.
At each turn, submit one move.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Uchaze umthombo ongasebenziyo okanye inqaba ekujoliswe kuyo.
invalid_move.same_tower: Uzamile ukuhambisa idiski kweso sakhiwo sinye.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Uzame ukubeka idiski enkulu kwidiskhi encinane.

game_action.moved: Uhambise idiski {disk} ukusuka ku-{source} ukuya kwi-{target}.

outcome.turn_limit: Umda wenguqu ufikelelwe. Ubekwe ngokuchanekileyo {pct}% yeediski kwiNqaba C.
